  main{max-width:920px;}

  .lec-card.is-draft .lec-preview{aspect-ratio:16/9;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d9d3cb;}
  .lec-status{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:700;}
</style>
